# nirvana_networking_firewall_rules (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nirvana_networking_firewall_rules" "example_networking_firewall_rules" {
  vpc_id = "vpc_id"
  name = "name"
  protocol = "tcp"
  status = "ready"
  tags = ["string"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String)

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (String) Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the Firewall Rule name
- `protocol` (String) Filter by protocol
Available values: "tcp", "udp".
- `sort` (String) Comma-separated sort terms in precedence order, each field:asc or field:desc. Fields: created_at, updated_at, name, status, protocol
- `status` (String) Filter by Firewall Rule status
Available values: "pending", "creating", "updating", "ready", "deleting", "error".
- `tags` (List of String) Filter by tags. Repeat the parameter to require several tags; a Firewall Rule must carry all of them.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What the Firewall Rule does with the traffic it matches. Rules you create allow traffic.
Available values: "allow", "deny".
- `created_at` (String) When the Firewall Rule was created.
- `destination_address` (String) Destination address of the Firewall Rule. For an ingress rule, either VPC CIDR or VM in VPC.
- `destination_ports` (List of String) Destination ports of the Firewall Rule.
- `direction` (String) Direction of the traffic the Firewall Rule matches. Rules you create are ingress rules.
Available values: "ingress", "egress".
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Firewall Rule.
- `managed_by` (Attributes) What manages the resource, or null when nothing does. A managed resource can be read but not changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--managed_by))
- `name` (String) Name of the Firewall Rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of the Firewall Rule.
Available values: "tcp", "udp".
- `source_address` (String) Source address of the Firewall Rule. Address of 0.0.0.0 requires a CIDR mask of 0. For an egress rule, the VPC CIDR.
- `status` (String) Status of the resource.
Available values: "pending", "creating", "updating", "ready", "deleting", "deleted", "error", "suspended".
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to attach to the Firewall Rule.
- `updated_at` (String) When the Firewall Rule was updated.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC the Firewall Rule belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--items--managed_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.managed_by`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the thing managing the resource. For a vpc_egress_policy, the ID of the VPC.
- `type` (String) Kind of thing managing the resource. A vpc_egress_policy manages the Firewall Rules that block outbound traffic to ports commonly used for abuse.
Available values: "sandbox_cluster", "vpc_egress_policy".
